name: MNR Scene Manager
_comment_version: version, channel, built and commit are written by the Stamp plugin version action on every push to main (version = version_base.<build>). Edit only version_base by hand.
_comment_install_type: scriptui_panel. Installs into the After Effects install folder (Support Files/Scripts/ScriptUI Panels), which is the only location a dockable panel reliably loads from. That path needs a UAC prompt.
notes: MNR_Scene_Manager.jsx (open, new, save as, rename pipeline .aep work files; was MNR_Launcher_Panel.jsx) and MNR_AE_Exporter.jsx (publish renders: EXR, MP4 preview, PNG proxy) are the panels MNR Launcher installs, plus the two Scripts/Startup files. MNR_Feature_Catalog.jsx is a showroom of ScriptUI widgets, not shipped to artists. tools/ holds one-time admin scripts, not installed.
